name: markets.pricedin/pricedin
title: PricedIn
description: AI-native consensus earnings estimates, drivers, company briefs, and graded track record.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Returns the directory of companies with their report days, quarter slugs, whether a company brief exists, and which of the four report pages each quarter has (full or headline).

tools.name: get_estimates
tools.description: Returns headline sales and EPS (low, PricedIn base, high), YoY growth, company guidance and vs_outlook, margins, capex, FCF, and last release result across companies (<= 25 KB per page). Defaults to next_quarter + year_1 across all companies, or all 5 horizons when tickers or horizon="all" is given. Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share. A 14-day free trial or subscriber key (Authorization: Bearer) opens the full page of a gated name.

tickers.description: ticker array such as ["NVDA", "COHR"] or comma-separated string "NVDA,COHR"

cursor.description: optional next_cursor from the previous page

tools.name: get_drivers
tools.description: Returns verbatim qualitative drivers (call, eps summary, models debate, watch, low/base/high case summaries), operating segment estimates, and latest after-call management takeaways for a basket of tickers (~8-10 companies per 25 KB call). Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share. A 14-day free trial or subscriber key (Authorization: Bearer) opens the full page of a gated name.

tickers.description: ticker array such as ["NVDA", "COHR"] or comma-separated string "NVDA,COHR"

cursor.description: optional next_cursor from the previous page

tools.name: search
tools.description: BM25 keyword, stem and "exact phrase" search across published forecasts, release reviews, after-call quotes and company briefs. Defaults to each company's latest pages so superseded quarters do not pollute hits; pass scope="all" for prior quarters. A 14-day free trial or subscriber key (Authorization: Bearer) opens the full page of a gated name.

q.description: keywords or "quoted phrases", e.g. '800G optical transceiver'

tickers.description: ticker array such as ["NVDA", "COHR"] or comma-separated string "NVDA,COHR"

cursor.description: optional next_cursor from the previous page

tools.name: get_company_brief
tools.description: Returns the How the company works brief from the company's annual report (up to 4 tickers per call): how it makes money, what it sells, unit economics, competitive position, cost inputs, and upside/downside anatomy.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Returns every graded quarter on PricedIn: our pre-release forecast beside the Street's estimate, the reported result, the closest model, and next-quarter guidance checks. Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share.

cursor.description: optional next_cursor from the previous page

tools.name: get_quarter_forecast
tools.description: Returns the Quarter forecast page for one company and quarter (defaults to "latest"), as the site shows it: our forecast of the quarter to be reported and the one after. Without part, returns "top" (<= 25 KB): headline, each period's low, base and high with each model's numbers, and "parts", the list of other parts. Pass part "table", a horizon alias ("next_quarter", "year_1"), a period such as "FY2027", or "full" (the whole unsplit JSON for code-execution sandboxes). Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share. A 14-day free trial or subscriber key (Authorization: Bearer) opens the full page of a gated name.

quarter.description: optional: defaults to "latest" for this page kind, or fq3-2026 style as list_companies names it

part.description: optional: defaults to "top" (<= 25 KB); pass "table", a horizon alias ("next_quarter", "quarter_after", "current_year", "year_1", "year_2"), an exact period ("FY2027"), or "full" for the entire unsplit document

tools.name: get_release_review
tools.description: Returns the Release review page for one company and quarter (defaults to "latest"), as the site shows it: what the company reported against our forecast, line by line, with the bridge, the company's outlook and the reasons. Free in full on every company. Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share.

quarter.description: optional: defaults to "latest" for this page kind, or fq3-2026 style as list_companies names it

tools.name: get_after_the_call
tools.description: Returns the After the call page for one company and quarter (defaults to "latest"), as the site shows it: the call in brief (the takeaways of the release and the call, what management stressed, and what analysts asked, each line with its quote), what moved in our forecast after the call and why, and the company's new outlook. The new forecast itself is the Full forecast page of the next quarter. Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share. A 14-day free trial or subscriber key (Authorization: Bearer) opens the full page of a gated name.

quarter.description: optional: defaults to "latest" for this page kind, or fq3-2026 style as list_companies names it

tools.name: get_full_forecast
tools.description: Returns the Full forecast page for one company and quarter (defaults to "latest"), as the site shows it: our forecast of the next quarter, the quarter after and three years. Without part, returns "top" (<= 25 KB): headline, each period's low, base and high with each model's numbers, and "parts", the list of other parts. Pass part "table", a horizon alias ("next_quarter", "year_1"), a period such as "FY2027", or "full" (the whole unsplit JSON for code-execution sandboxes). Money is in US dollars, not thousands or millions: 113271666666.667 is $113.27 billion. Earnings per share is in dollars per share. A 14-day free trial or subscriber key (Authorization: Bearer) opens the full page of a gated name.

quarter.description: optional: defaults to "latest" for this page kind, or fq3-2026 style as list_companies names it

part.description: optional: defaults to "top" (<= 25 KB); pass "table", a horizon alias ("next_quarter", "quarter_after", "current_year", "year_1", "year_2"), an exact period ("FY2027"), or "full" for the entire unsplit document
